plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/staging/room-11/plate-01/candidate-1920x864.png: room-11 attempt 2 with attempt 4's portrait, the standard 20:9 crop -- frame.json). Every rect below was read off that picture with a grid over it.
walkableNote: THE CARPET IN FRONT OF EVERYTHING. The chairs' feet are at y 650, the desk's at 720, the sideboard's at 650 and the safe's at 770. So the band runs y 735-855 from the door's step (x 205) to the safe (x 1640).

scaling.note: ROOM 11'S DEPTH, FROM THE MAN THE MASTER PAINTED. The composition master drew Thad about 405 tall with his feet at source y 800, which is 512 at y 796 in this plate's frame; along Room 5's slope (0.69 per row) that is 470 at the band's far edge and 553 at its near. Fanshawe stands behind his desk at y 675, at 404 on the same curve (tools/art/room11-fanshawe.py).

entrances.note: In by the door from the lobby, at left.
Anything else arrives by the door.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32). THE STOCK PORTRAIT DRAWER is the sideboard with its drawer not quite closed; THE DECANTER stands on it. THE HANDKERCHIEF and THE SUBMISSION LOG are the linen and the green book on the desk; Fanshawe stands between them. The desk itself is no subject.

lamps.note: The oil lamp on Fanshawe's desk. A slow, low breath (invariant 9).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object here is looked at on a bare click.

occlusion.note: NO PLANE MASKS THAT CAN REACH HIM: the walk band is in front of every piece of furniture; Fanshawe is cut at his desk top by his own posture.
